# v26.0 WP10: Fixed 30y wave timer, O(1) annual GUI region ownership cache, real Extend Romanization
# movement relaunch, and AI BYZ/ROM Romanization/Pentarchy parity tick.
# Generated by gen_v260_cul_rel_overhaul.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_identity_schedule_30_years = {
    $holder$ = {
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_identity_fixed_30y_scheduled } }
            set_variable = oe_identity_fixed_30y_scheduled
            location:constantinople = {
                trigger_event_silently = { id = $event$ years = 30 }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. Refreshes all 20 Romanization region ownership counts once per year (and on game start)
# so oe_roman_assimilation.gui never scans regions on render frames.
oe_rw_refresh_region_count_cache = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rw_cache_total_turkish value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rw_cache_owned_turkish value = 0 }
    region:anatolia_region = {
        every_location_in_region = {
            limit = { is_ownable = yes }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_rw_cache_total_turkish add = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_is_phoenix_bloc = yes } }
                change_global_variable = { name = oe_rw_cache_owned_turkish add = 1 }
            }

# Country scope (BYZ/ROM). Called by oe_as2.5 (Extend Romanization): clears 10y wave cooldowns for
# expired incomplete waves and re-launches every eligible region still holding >= 25% source pops.
oe_as2_relaunch_incomplete_movements = {
    custom_tooltip = oe_as2_relaunch_incomplete_movements_tt
    hidden_effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes }
            oe_rw_refresh_region_count_cache = yes
            if = {
                limit = {
                    culture:oe_tur_greek_culture = {
                        NOT = { any_movement_in_culture = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_turkish_identity_movement } }
                        has_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd
                    }
                }
                culture:oe_tur_greek_culture = { remove_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd }
                oe_rw_start_turkish_romanization = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    culture:oe_egypt_greek_culture = {
                        NOT = { any_movement_in_culture = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_egypt_identity_movement } }
                        has_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd
                    }
                }
                culture:oe_egypt_greek_culture = { remove_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd }
                oe_rw_start_egypt_romanization = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    culture:oe_levantine_greek_culture = {
                        NOT = { any_movement_in_culture = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_syria_identity_movement } }
                        has_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd
                    }
                }
                culture:oe_levantine_greek_culture = { remove_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd }
                oe_rw_start_syria_romanization = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    culture:oe_tunis_greek_culture = {
                        NOT = { any_movement_in_culture = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_africa_identity_movement } }
                        has_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd
                    }
                }
                culture:oe_tunis_greek_culture = { remove_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd }
                oe_rw_start_africa_romanization = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    culture:oe_french_greek_culture = {
                        NOT = { any_movement_in_culture = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_gaul_identity_movement } }
                        has_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd
                    }
                }
                culture:oe_french_greek_culture = { remove_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd }
                oe_rw_start_gaul_romanization = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    culture:oe_iberia_greek_culture = {
                        NOT = { any_movement_in_culture = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_iberia_identity_movement } }
                        has_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd
                    }
                }
                culture:oe_iberia_greek_culture = { remove_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd }
                oe_rw_start_iberia_romanization = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    culture:oe_english_greek_culture = {
                        NOT = { any_movement_in_culture = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_britain_identity_movement } }
                        has_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd
                    }
                }
                culture:oe_english_greek_culture = { remove_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd }
                oe_rw_start_britain_romanization = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    culture:oe_serbian_greek_culture = {
                        NOT = { any_movement_in_culture = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_serbia_identity_movement } }
                        has_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd
                    }
                }
                culture:oe_serbian_greek_culture = { remove_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd }
                oe_rw_start_serbia_romanization = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    culture:oe_bulgarian_greek_culture = {
                        NOT = { any_movement_in_culture = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_bulgaria_identity_movement } }

            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    culture:oe_albanian_greek_culture = {
                        NOT = { any_movement_in_culture = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_albania_identity_movement } }
                        has_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd
                    }
                }
                culture:oe_albanian_greek_culture = { remove_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd }
                oe_rw_start_albania_romanization = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    culture:oe_croatian_greek_culture = {
                        NOT = { any_movement_in_culture = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_illyria_identity_movement } }
                        has_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd
                    }
                }
                culture:oe_croatian_greek_culture = { remove_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd }
                oe_rw_start_illyria_romanization = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    culture:oe_latin_greek_culture = {
                        NOT = { any_movement_in_culture = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_latin_identity_movement } }
                        has_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd
                    }
                }
                culture:oe_latin_greek_culture = { remove_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd }
                oe_rw_start_latin_romanization = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    culture:oe_german_greek_culture = {
                        NOT = { any_movement_in_culture = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_german_identity_movement } }
                        has_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd
                    }
                }
                culture:oe_german_greek_culture = { remove_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd }
                oe_rw_start_german_romanization = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    culture:oe_moldova_greek_culture = {
                        NOT = { any_movement_in_culture = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_dacia_identity_movement } }
                        has_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd
                    }
                }
                culture:oe_moldova_greek_culture = { remove_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd }
                oe_rw_start_dacia_romanization = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    culture:oe_paeones_culture = {
                        NOT = { any_movement_in_culture = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_paeones_identity_movement } }
                        has_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd
                    }
                }
                culture:oe_paeones_culture = { remove_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd }
                oe_rw_start_paeones_romanization = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    culture:oe_armenian_greek_culture = {
                        NOT = { any_movement_in_culture = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_armenian_identity_movement } }
                        has_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd
                    }
                }
                culture:oe_armenian_greek_culture = { remove_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd }
                oe_rw_start_armenia_romanization = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    culture:griko_culture = {
                        NOT = { any_movement_in_culture = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_griko_identity_movement } }
                        has_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd
                    }
                }
                culture:griko_culture = { remove_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd }
                oe_rw_start_griko_romanization = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    culture:oe_mesopotamian_culture = {
                        NOT = { any_movement_in_culture = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_mesopotamia_identity_movement } }
                        has_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd
                    }
                }
                culture:oe_mesopotamian_culture = { remove_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd }
                oe_rw_start_mesopotamia_romanization = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    culture:oe_kudoyr_culture = {
                        NOT = { any_movement_in_culture = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_kudoyr_identity_movement } }
                        has_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd
                    }
                }
                culture:oe_kudoyr_culture = { remove_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd }
                oe_rw_start_kudoyr_romanization = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    culture:oe_georgian_greek_culture = {
                        NOT = { any_movement_in_culture = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_georgia_identity_movement } }
                        has_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd
                    }
                }
                culture:oe_georgian_greek_culture = { remove_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd }
                oe_rw_start_georgia_romanization = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    religion:orthodox = {
                        NOT = { any_movement_in_religion = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_orthodox_identity_movement } }
                        has_variable = oe_pentarchy_wave_cd
                    }
                }
                religion:orthodox = { remove_variable = oe_pentarchy_wave_cd }
                oe_rw_start_pentarchy_romanization = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

# Country scope (AI BYZ/ROM). Lightweight O(1) annual parity tick: launches Pentarchy or 1 ready region per year.
oe_as2_ai_romanization_tick = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_ai = yes
            oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes
            NOT = { oe_rule_is_global_arcs_player_only = yes }
            at_war = no
            gold >= 250
        }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_rw_start_pentarchy_romanization_allowed = yes }
            oe_rw_start_pentarchy_romanization = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_rw_start_turkish_romanization_allowed = yes }
            oe_rw_start_turkish_romanization = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_rw_start_bulgaria_romanization_allowed = yes }
            oe_rw_start_bulgaria_romanization = yes
